# Ordinary array optional positioning

The installed fixture preserves 106 complete MathJax 3.2.2 original records from source `ad8f5c21cb810236551da8c6512ba733e67357ee`. The initial capture made 58 fresh public conversions and reused 48 complete published residual originals at actual base `16801f1f0e8e5c0b1582224cce85140b1093ed38`. A subsequent original-only run freshly rendered all 106 inputs and reproduced the archive byte for byte. Complete historical metadata, residual records and preparation-era status strings inside the archive remain unchanged; the receipts below supersede those historical status fields.

All 106 originals are valid XML: 96 normal SVGs and ten error SVGs. The qualified candidate matches every complete original SVG, with 86 fixes and 20 unchanged exact controls. Publication accounting is 58 first SVG inputs (38 fixes and 20 controls) plus 48 prior held originals promoted to strict assertions. There are no safeXML or original-runtime cases in this focused fixture.

The production source is `d114575e4d54542cf119eafa77750a6c36b1a3f9`, with internal tree `2a6e7a69fbd7304adb13472da0e12b14797568db`. It reads an optional position only for `array`, before the mandatory column specification. Alignment is applied to the inner table before column rules can wrap it, and direct Pop bypasses final table metadata. The corpus covers t/b/c and custom literal alignment, empty/absent arguments, JavaScript whitespace and control spaces, grouped/escaped brackets, reader diagnostics, partial frames, nested arrays, generated/swallowed Ends, direct Pop, and adjacent Array/AMS routes.

The public test uses `DefaultOptions` with explicit display mode and compares the entire SVG with `original.svg`. It also verifies that all 48 complete historical residual records remain unchanged, including their old held reasons. Their former mismatch is not a requirement. The original archive, generator and formatted test were installed; the selected Go test passed. No Go-produced SVG is an expected output.

Completed validation:

- Focused candidate: 106 exact original SVGs, 86 fixes, 20 controls, no regressions or changed nonexact outputs.
- Original-only regeneration: 106 fresh VMs and complete LF-framed API objects, one byte-identical archive; independent source and invocation reviews passed. The complete response stream is retained; no separate shell stdout/stderr logs were saved for that original invocation.
- Protected public replay: 146,591 unique requests and 164,663 source associations. It includes the same 86 fixes; they are not additional fixes. No genuine source or consumer regressions occurred, and 2,135 original-runtime requests stayed unchanged. Four inherited cancellation attribute-order variations were qualified by 512 repeated complete responses and excluded from fix totals.
- D2: both new top/bottom witnesses and all 100 prior references match complete original SVGs (102 total). Each new comparison uses one shared scale; root and independent reviewers viewed both screenshots and found them readable and unclipped. Fixed and original PNGs are also byte-identical.

Full Go tests, race tests, `go vet`, WASM compilation and exact-head hosted checks are still required before merge. The production commit above is the measured source anchor; no final artifact commit or merge is asserted by this metadata revision.

## Original-only regeneration

Run the pinned Node binary with `generate_array_optional_position.cjs PINNED_ASSET_DIR NEW_OUTPUT_DIR`. The generator verifies the Node and three frozen asset hashes, creates a fresh VM per request, and uses explicit display, Em=16, Ex=8 and no font cache. Each detached full API object is streamed to `fresh-observations.jsonl` before yielding. Any exception or complete-object mismatch fails the run with evidence retained. The archive is copied only after all 106 fresh API objects match, preserving all source fields and historical provenance byte for byte.

No seeded or injected profile is included. A separately retained plan proposes passive observations of 16 existing default-profile inputs; it remains unimplemented and contributes no new inputs or assertions. No native-event, counter, or cursor parity is claimed.

The inventory binds the focused, protected, selected-Go, regeneration and D2 receipts. Earlier source-only drafts, v1 diagnostic mismatches and the first D2 delimiter failure remain historical scratch evidence; none rewrites the source originals or current SVGs.
